_note: TWO SIZING NOTES BEFORE YOU CHANGE ANYTHING HERE. The composite size must exceed the (agent, host) cardinality in the window - on the stage profile that is ~990 pairs, and patient zero sorts around rank 550, so a size of 200 silently pages it out of the first result set. And the window is 2h rather than the slide's 1h because the metronome runs at 2 calls a minute: with a 1h window and a _count > 60 threshold, the alert stops firing ~30 minutes after you load the data. 2h buys about 90 minutes of drift, and benign agents still only reach ~6 fetches per (agent, host) pair in that time. Slide 22, corrected in three further places. (1) A bucket_level_trigger condition requires BOTH buckets_path and parent_bucket_path - the slide omits them and the monitor will not save without them. (2) The slide counts spans with value_count on 'spanId', but slide 14 sets doc_values:false on trace.spanId precisely so it is never aggregated; params._count from the composite bucket is free and correct. (3) The volume threshold. See docs/SLIDE-VS-REALITY.md item 7: at 4 KB every 30 seconds this agent moves ~492 KB an hour, which is why slide 3 says the volume sat inside the daily quota. Thresholding on 5e7 bytes would never fire. The signal is the flat line, not the volume - which is the thesis of the talk, so the condition should say so.
